Name: Seasonal Flower Sprinklers Refreshed
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
Beautify your farm this mod that transforms sprinklers into  seasonal flowers. Includes artwork from JennaJuffuffles and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/83494008?tab=user+files]Amaryn (Maraluna7)[/url]. 

Prefer to use this mod with Alternative Textures? No problem!  Simply download the  AT version supplied here for the vanilla style or the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6000]original file[/url] from Amaryn. (Also: I've included Nozzle and Enricher but I really don't think that's supported by AT right now from my testing.)

[url=https://i.imgur.com/X3ldWJU.png]Artwork used with permission[/url], and so grateful Amaryn let me make these sprinklers accessible for everyone again!
